title: Make CSV rerun state first-class in Queue
summary: Adds a backend-owned CSV rerun Queue read model and renders it as first-class Queue state with normalized statuses, evidence fields, filters, and backend-routed actions.
reason: CSV rerun is a dedicated audit-remediation workflow that should be visible and operable from Queue without converting rerun rows into normal `/api/pipeline/start` queue rows or moving publish/replacement decisions into the WebView.
behavior_before: Queue could show limited CSV rerun manifest fallback evidence, but CSV rerun rows did not have a first-class Queue state table with normalized statuses, destination/review/publish evidence, or row actions.
behavior_after: GET /api/rerun/results exposes `desktop_rerun_queue_state.v1` rows with backend-normalized statuses and `uses_pipeline_start=false`; the Queue CSV Rerun tab renders those rows even when normal queue rows are empty, filters by backend status, and routes open/promote/stop/continue actions through `/api/rerun/*` with existing confirmations.
tests_added: test_process_rerun_results.py first-class CSV rerun Queue state mapping
test_application_facade_queue.py CSV rerun manifest fallback status projection expansion
test_application_facade_web_static_queue.py Queue CSV Rerun state table and route pins
test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py rerun promote route ownership and confirmation pins
test_webview_browser_launch_queue_readiness_smoke.py Queue CSV Rerun state control smoke assertions
manual_validation: refresh_summaries --paths for Phase 3 touched files - passed
refresh_summaries --check --paths for Phase 3 source/docs - passed (17 source files)
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue CSV rerun read-model projection, Queue tab state table rendering/actions, route-boundary classifier update, and associated tests/docs; restore `/api/rerun/results` to the prior manifest-results payload while leaving `/api/rerun/*` lifecycle routes intact.
notes: No frontend cleanliness or replacement decision logic was added. Queue rendering uses backend-provided `queue_state` rows and row actions; CSV rerun rows remain marked `uses_pipeline_start=false` and actions continue through `/api/rerun/*`.
